newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian court fines Italian fishermen.
newsitem.headline: Croatian court fines Italian fishermen.

text.p: A Croatian court on Thursday fined Italian fishermen almost $10,000 for illegally fishing in its territorial waters, state media said.
A Croatian naval patrol intercepted and detained the "Darno" boat on Wednesday after spotting it on Tuesday evening sailing one km (half a mile) inside Croatian waters.
A court in the Istrian peninsula town of Pula ordered the captain of the Darno, from the Italian port of Chioggia near Venice, to pay the 54,000 kuna fine before leaving Croatia.
The court also seized the catch and the fishing net found on the Darno, the state news agency Hina said.
When the boat tried to escape despite warning shots, naval police fired and hit its mast, Croatian authorities said. The vessel then stopped.
